content: As shown by Fig. FIGREF2, the singer classification network and pitch regression network have the same architecture of a stack of two convolutional neural networks with a kernel size of 3 and channels of 100. Except that the pitch regression network does not average the output of the two convolution networks before passing it into the final fully connected network. A dropout layer is also employed at the beginning of the network to make the training process more stable.
